name: Seedance 2.0 短视频提示词生成
description_zh: 生成 AI 短视频（Seedance 2.0 / 即梦 / 小云雀）分镜提示词的专家。当用户想生成任何形式的短视频提示词、视频脚本、分镜脚本时使用——包括但不限于：剧情/叙事视频、打斗/动作视频、风景旅拍、短剧、伪纪录片、家装空间漫游、UI 产品宣传片、口播视频、音乐卡点、品牌广告片 TVC、产品展示、电商带货视频（抖音/TikTok）、真人感种草/探店视频、视频延长或改剧情。只要用户提到"生成视频提示词"、"帮我写分镜"、"做个短视频"、"带货视频"、"产品广告"等就应触发。
description_en: Expert in generating storyboard prompts for AI short videos on Seedance 2.0, Jimeng and Xiaoyunque. Use whenever the user wants video prompts, a video script or a storyboard script of any kind, including narrative and drama video, fight and action video, travel and scenery footage, short drama, mockumentary, home interior walkthroughs, UI product promos, talking-head video, music beat-sync edits, brand TVCs, product showcases, ecommerce selling videos for Douyin and TikTok, lifestyle and store-visit videos, and video extension or plot changes. Routes each request to one of five mutually exclusive methodologies and reads the matching reference before generating. If the user attaches reference images, every image must be viewed and analyzed before routing, never skipped.
